catalog.name: Swap
catalog.about: Exchanges one Solana token for another in a single transaction you sign. Salmon prepares the transaction from the quote of a routing provider and shows you every number before you confirm; the swap runs on the network, between you and its programs. Salmon charges a 0.5% fee, shown as its own line.
catalog.usage: Pick what you pay with, what you receive and how much. Review the quote, then sign.

actions.swap: Exchange one token for another with a 0.5% Salmon fee

review.title: Swap Review
review.highImpactBody: This swap moves the price by {{percent}}%. You may receive noticeably less than the market rate.

errors.buildFailed: Couldn't prepare the swap. Try again.
errors.tokenNotSupported: This token can't be swapped right now.
